title: A Museum Robbery
statementMd:
There's a famous museum in the city where Kleofáš lives. In the museum, $*n*$ exhibits (numbered $1$ through $*n*$) had been displayed for a long time; the $*i*$-th of those exhibits has value $*v*_{*i*}$ and mass $*w*_{*i*}$.

Then, the museum was bought by a large financial group and started to vary the exhibits. At about the same time, Kleofáš... gained interest in the museum, so to say.

You should process $*q*$ events of three types:

- type $1$ — the museum displays an exhibit with value $*v*$ and mass $*w*$; the exhibit displayed in the $*i*$-th event of this type is numbered $*n* + *i*$ (see sample explanation for more details)
- type $2$ — the museum removes the exhibit with number $*x*$ and stores it safely in its vault
- type $3$ — Kleofáš visits the museum and wonders (for no important reason at all, of course): if there was a robbery and exhibits with total mass at most $*m*$ were stolen, what would their maximum possible total value be?

For each event of type 3, let $*s*(*m*)$ be the maximum possible total value of stolen exhibits with total mass $≤ *m*$.

Formally, let $*D*$ be the set of numbers of all exhibits that are currently displayed (so initially $*D*$ = {1, ..., n}). Let $*P*(*D*)$ be the set of all subsets of $*D*$ and let

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2d29385d7a96042070a59354d9aa9dbbb3b0cfbe.png)

Then, $*s*(*m*)$ is defined as

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e44e3f211ddf59e954fe7d37e335aec12b26f686.png)

Compute $*s*(*m*)$ for each ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34ca452cd2f1c2ab8922517e9cc383e39874d188.png). Note that the output follows a special format.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$) — the initial number of exhibits in the museum and the maximum interesting mass of stolen exhibits.

Then, $*n*$ lines follow. The $*i*$-th of them contains two space-separated positive integers $*v*_{*i*}$ and $*w*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000 000$, $1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$) — the value and mass of the $*i*$-th exhibit.

The next line contains a single integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 30 000$) — the number of events.

Each of the next $*q*$ lines contains the description of one event in the following format:

- $1 *v* *w*$ — an event of type 1, a new exhibit with value $*v*$ and mass $*w*$ has been added ($1 ≤ *v* ≤ 1 000 000$, $1 ≤ *w* ≤ 1000$)
- $2 *x*$ — an event of type 2, the exhibit with number $*x*$ has been removed; it's guaranteed that the removed exhibit had been displayed at that time
- $3$ — an event of type 3, Kleofáš visits the museum and asks his question

There will be at most $10 000$ events of type 1 and at least one event of type 3.

## Output

As the number of values $*s*(*m*)$ can get large, output the answers to events of type 3 in a special format.

For each event of type 3, consider the values $*s*(*m*)$ computed for the question that Kleofáš asked in this event; print one line containing a single number

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8c5de0bab73c4e43c77c59eb44795e974a5dafc.png)

where $*p* = 10^{7} + 19$ and $*q* = 10^{9} + 7$.

Print the answers to events of type 3 in the order in which they appear in the input.

## Note

In the first sample, the numbers of displayed exhibits and values $*s*(1), ..., *s*(10)$ for individual events of type 3 are, in order:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd9cbad4d6c8ba8cdbbf9a3b1ef42e9d8439383d.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f95fffbd0c32b53ec1f8c00688e1775113ec087.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c49fc439dd31d787510f0baee9823491dd48f14a.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a41a35d4c3c56e9e060570bd222583645efb2798.png)

The values of individual exhibits are $*v*_{1} = 30, *v*_{2} = 60, *v*_{3} = 5, *v*_{4} = 42, *v*_{5} = 20, *v*_{6} = 40$ and their masses are $*w*_{1} = 4, *w*_{2} = 6, *w*_{3} = 1, *w*_{4} = 5, *w*_{5} = 3, *w*_{6} = 6$.

In the second sample, the only question is asked after removing all exhibits, so $*s*(*m*) = 0$ for any $*m*$.
statementZhMd:
市里有一座著名的博物馆，Kleofáš 就住在那里。博物馆中长期陈列着 $*n*$ 件展品（编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$）；其中第 $*i*$ 件展品的价值为 $*v*_{*i*}$，质量为 $*w*_{*i*}$。

后来，博物馆被一个大型金融集团收购，并开始不断更换展品。大约与此同时，Kleofáš……可以说，对博物馆产生了兴趣。

你需要处理 $*q*$ 个事件，它们有以下三种类型：

- 类型 $1$ — 博物馆陈列一件价值为 $*v*$、质量为 $*w*$ 的展品；第 $*i*$ 个此类事件中陈列的展品编号为 $*n* + *i*$（详情请参见样例解释）
- 类型 $2$ — 博物馆移除编号为 $*x*$ 的展品，并将其安全地存放在金库中
- 类型 $3$ — Kleofáš 参观博物馆，并思考（当然，完全没有任何重要原因）：如果发生了盗窃，窃贼偷走的展品总质量不超过 $*m*$，那么这些展品的总价值最大可能是多少？

对于每个类型 $3$ 的事件，令 $*s*(*m*)$ 表示总质量 $≤ *m*$ 的被盗展品的最大总价值。

形式化地，令 $*D*$ 为当前正在陈列的所有展品的编号集合（因此初始时 $*D*$ = {1, ..., n}）。令 $*P*(*D*)$ 为 $*D*$ 的所有子集组成的集合，并令

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2d29385d7a96042070a59354d9aa9dbbb3b0cfbe.png)

那么，$*s*(*m*)$ 定义为

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e44e3f211ddf59e954fe7d37e335aec12b26f686.png)

请计算每个 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34ca452cd2f1c2ab8922517e9cc383e39874d188.png) 对应的 $*s*(*m*)$。注意，输出需要遵循特殊格式。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$），分别表示博物馆中初始展品数量，以及被盗展品的最大关注质量。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个用空格分隔的正整数 $*v*_{*i*}$ 和 $*w*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000 000$，$1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$），表示第 $*i*$ 件展品的价值和质量。

下一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 30 000$），表示事件的数量。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，每行按照以下格式描述一个事件：

- $1 *v* *w*$ — 类型 $1$ 事件，添加一件价值为 $*v*$、质量为 $*w*$ 的新展品（$1 ≤ *v* ≤ 1 000 000$，$1 ≤ *w* ≤ 1000$）
- $2 *x*$ — 类型 $2$ 事件，移除编号为 $*x*$ 的展品；保证该展品在此时正在陈列
- $3$ — 类型 $3$ 事件，Kleofáš 参观博物馆并提出问题

类型 $1$ 的事件最多有 $10 000$ 个，类型 $3$ 的事件至少有一个。

## 输出格式

由于 $*s*(*m*)$ 的数值可能很大，请按照特殊格式输出类型 $3$ 事件的答案。

对于每个类型 $3$ 的事件，考虑 Kleofáš 在该事件中提出的问题所对应的 $*s*(*m*)$ 的值；输出一行，其中包含一个数值

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8c5de0bab73c4e43c77c59eb44795e974a5dafc.png)

其中 $*p* = 10^{7} + 19$，$*q* = 10^{9} + 7$。

按照类型 $3$ 事件在输入中出现的顺序输出答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，各个类型 $3$ 事件依次对应的陈列展品数量，以及 $*s*(1), ..., *s*(10)$ 的值为：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd9cbad4d6c8ba8cdbbf9a3b1ef42e9d8439383d.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f95fffbd0c32b53ec1f8c00688e1775113ec087.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c49fc439dd31d787510f0baee9823491dd48f14a.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a41a35d4c3c56e9e060570bd222583645efb2798.png)

各件展品的价值分别为 $*v*_{1} = 30, *v*_{2} = 60, *v*_{3} = 5, *v*_{4} = 42, *v*_{5} = 20, *v*_{6} = 40$，质量分别为 $*w*_{1} = 4, *w*_{2} = 6, *w*_{3} = 1, *w*_{4} = 5, *w*_{5} = 3, *w*_{6} = 6$。

在第二个样例中，唯一的问题是在移除所有展品后提出的，因此对于任意 $*m*$ 都有 $*s*(*m*) = 0$。
